reviewer: Claude (research engineer, merit layouts batch 1), reviewed 2026-11-02, revised 2026-11-03 after the #299 review against the archived official pages

approve.reason: UND Automatic Academic Scholarships (freshmen admissions page): 'If you meet the criteria and submit your completed admission application, official transcripts(s), and - if required - your official test scores by the Feb. 1 priority deadline for the upcoming fall semester, you'll automatically be awarded one of the following academic scholarships.' Three tiers by unweighted cumulative high-school GPA: '3.90+ GPA or 30+ ACT (1370+ SAT) with 3.00+ GPA*' $14,000 ($3,500 / year for a maximum of 4 years); '3.70 - 3.89 GPA' $11,000 ($2,750 / year for a maximum of 4 years); '3.50 - 3.69 GPA' $1,500 non-renewable. The top tier's printed test path is stored as test_requirement ('30+ ACT (1370+ SAT) with 3.00+ GPA*'; '*You must submit official ACT or SAT test scores to qualify for this scholarship'). No award_min/max is set, because the printed figures mix four-year totals with annual amounts. Accepted issue alternative_criteria_in_tier: the GPA path and the test path share the top tier, copied as printed. No year printed: partially_verified.

reject.reason: Duplicate of the admissions-page grid on the financial-aid page ('Receive Up to $14,000 in Freshman Scholarships'). Its 2026-27 label comes from the heading '2026-27 Financial Aid Changes' (federal aid changes), an other-aid label that may not date the merit table; the year is never taken from it, and the admissions-page record is kept instead.
